example.name: create_new_plan
example.description: Creating a new plan following navigation rules
example.context: When starting a new project initiative that requires coordinated changes
example.code:
# Feature Enhancement Plan
## Purpose Implement new feature X to improve user experience and system performance. This change modifies the existing architecture to support additional functionality while maintaining backward compatibility.
## Scope This plan covers implementation of feature X across the following components: UI, backend services, configuration, and documentation.
## Entry Points - src/ui/widgets/main_window.py - src/services/feature_service.py - config/default.yml - docs/features.md
## Planned Changes - [ ] Update UI components to support new feature - [ ] Implement backend service logic - [ ] Add configuration options - [ ] Update documentation
## Test Coverage - Verify new feature works end-to-end → integration test - Verify backward compatibility → regression test - Verify performance requirements → benchmark test
## Dependencies ### Hard Dependencies - depends on: runtime-configuration-plan.md - blocks: ui-enhancement-plan.md
### Soft Dependencies - should be reviewed after: python-packages-structure.md
## Obsolete / To Be Removed - Legacy configuration options - Deprecated API endpoints - Outdated documentation sections
## Architectural Invariants - maintain API compatibility - preserve data integrity - ensure security standards
## Target Audience - developers - users
## Per-File Focus src/ui/widgets/main_window.py: - Add new feature UI elements - Update layout for new functionality
config/default.yml: - Add new configuration options - Maintain backward compatibility
## Completion Criteria - all Planned Changes checked - tests listed in Test Coverage are green - Obsolete items removed or explicitly deprecated
## Post-Implementation Notes - What changed from original plan - What was removed as obsolete - What should be refactored later
## Completed / Coordinating with Parallel Execution
### Completed Items - [ ] Update UI components to support new feature - [ ] Implement backend service logic
### Notes for Parallel Execution - Coordinate with UI team to ensure consistent design language - Backend implementation should not break existing API
example.explanation: This example demonstrates the complete template structure that all plans should follow according to the navigation rules. Each section serves a specific purpose in maintaining project consistency and coordination.

example.name: update_existing_plan
example.description: Updating an existing plan with implementation progress
example.context: When tracking progress on an ongoing plan
example.code:
## Completed / Coordinating with Parallel Execution
### Completed Items - [x] Update UI components to support new feature - completed by dev team - [x] Implement backend service logic - completed, includes error handling - [~] Add configuration options - partially completed, missing validation - [ ] Update documentation - pending
### Notes for Parallel Execution - UI components merged, ready for integration testing - Backend service logic validated with unit tests - Configuration validation needs to be added before finalizing - Documentation team should start working once configuration is finalized - Integration tests should begin after configuration completion
example.explanation: This example shows how to update the tracking section of a plan as work progresses, maintaining visibility into what's completed and what coordination is needed.

example.name: dependency_management
example.context: When a plan depends on or blocks other plans
example.code:
## Dependencies ### Hard Dependencies - depends on: python-package-definitions.md - Need new Python packages built before implementing services - blocks: systemd-service-definitions.md - Service definitions can't be created until packages exist
### Soft Dependencies - should be reviewed after: remove-pythonpath-plan.md - Implementation approach may change based on PYTHONPATH removal - should be coordinated with: home-manager-updates.md - Similar configuration changes should be consistent - affects: testing-plan.md - New functionality requires new test coverage
example.explanation: This example demonstrates how to clearly document both hard dependencies (required for execution) and soft dependencies (for coordination and awareness).
